api_or_mcp.read_write: Read + write. Writes: list create / add items, prospect add / update lifecycle / note / tags, webhook create, mail campaign draft / pause / resume / send / cancel (send and cancel need confirmed: true). Reads: enrichment, property and people search, comps, exports, drives, mail analytics, usage. Native first-party server, not only a Zapier / Pipedream wrapper.
